method.selection: Scanned 110 valid dialogue windows from the retained, calibrated local corpus. Fourteen varied candidates received small.en transcription; five complete, distinct and acoustically clean dialogues were selected.
method.sentencePolicy: Strict terminal-punctuation segmentation with no duration cap. Comma-linked clauses remain in the same sentence.
method.speakerPolicy: Narrator and two participants are stored as editable speaker records. Consecutive sentences from one uninterrupted turn share a turnId.
method.audioPolicy: Only trailing empty space was removed. Every final MP3 retains the full narrator prompt and complete dialogue, uses 44.1 kHz mono at 128 kbps, and received no synthetic denoising or speed change.
qualityChecks: manual transcript reconciliation against the calibrated source text
independent tiny.en ASR on all 57 final sentence windows
empty, overlapping and out-of-range segment checks
RMS level, peak, clipping, DC offset, silence and waveform-jump checks

deployment.note: The user explicitly authorized future five-dialogue batches to deploy without an additional permission checkpoint.
